svg.title: Total conversation savings
svg.desc: The saving of one Claude Code session on Opus 5.5 against the price without DensePack, with DensePack 2.0.2, and with DensePack 2.0.2 on an Opus 5.5 main agent and a Sonnet 5.5 subagent. Five files read, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $0.98. Five files read, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $0.51, 48.3% less. Five files read, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $0.28, 71.2% less. Architecture doc, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $0.74. Architecture doc, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $0.35, 52.8% less. Architecture doc, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $0.41, 43.9% less. Read-in-full architecture, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $1.81. Read-in-full architecture, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $0.87, 52.1% less. Read-in-full architecture, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $0.56, 69.3% less. Code trace, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $4.74. Code trace, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $2.36, 50.2% less. Code trace, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $1.48, 68.8% less.
